title: 第234章 狮牙城第233章 钓鱼佬永不空军
slug: 我在西幻世界独断万古
content_zh:
“没想到我的幻术天赋还能用在海钓上，还真是学无止境啊！”
莉莉丝正蹲在船舷边将那根细绳抛入海中，同时用幻术将附近的鱼群引导过来咬饵。
如此一来、修炼娱乐两不误。
天才般的想法！
正这么美滋滋地想着，余光忽然瞥见海平面上出现一道灰蓝色轮廓。
“这是……陆地？师傅！前面有陆地了！”
她扔掉绳子，从木箱上一跃而起，蹦蹦跳跳指着前方隐约浮现的陆地轮廓。
季天此时正看着艾琳娜和奥菲莉娅下棋，他早已注意到那片岛屿群。
中央最大的岛屿据地图所示就是狮牙城，依稀可见灰白色的石砌建筑从海岸边一直延伸到半山腰。
再向前行驶段距离，船只驶向狮牙城港口。
港口里停泊着几十艘船只、大小不一，有商船、渔船，以及几艘挂着教会旗帜的巡逻舰。
最显眼的是一座建在港口入口处的石砌灯塔，塔身刷着红白相间的条纹，顶端镶嵌着枚巨大的魔法晶石。
海雀号船长伊芙琳的声音从舵轮旁传来：
“狮牙城到了，这里是南境群岛第二大的自由港，也是这片海域为数不多的有王国驻军的港口。我把船靠到西侧码头，那里离治安所和港口管理处都比较近。”
海雀号缓缓减速，帆面被水手们依次收拢，船身随着余势滑入港口的防波堤内。
伊芙琳熟练地操控着舵轮，让船身平稳地靠上西侧码头的石砌泊位。
码头上很快便聚起了一群看热闹的人。
船身的木料与石砌码头轻轻碰了一下，发出沉闷的声响，水手们抛出缆绳，利落地将船系牢。
伊芙琳拍了拍手上的灰，“到了，你们可以先办正事，我守着船。”
季天跳下船，靴子落在码头的石板上，发出清脆的声响，码头工人和附近的港口办事员的目光不约而同聚了过来。

他身上的银白色勇者轻甲在午后的阳光下泛着冷光，腰间挂着圣剑，在自由港的码头格外显眼。
几名码头工人低声交头接耳，有人已经认出了他肩甲处的勇者徽记。
“那是……勇者？”
“不会吧？勇者大人怎么会跑到南境海域来？不是应该在大陆上冒险吗？”
“你看他腰间的剑，和教会宣传的一模一样。”
“可…不是说这届勇者还有圣山吗？”
“海岛是教会的地盘，怎么可能有人敢冒充勇者大人？我估计是只有信仰虔诚的人才能看到圣山。”
“我看到了，好大一座山！”
“我…我也是。”
“……”
行人观察着季天等人的同时，季天几人也在观察行人。
码头上那些兽人引起了季天的注意。
长着毛茸茸猫耳、身后拖着细长尾巴的猫耳兽人的身影在人群中并不罕见：
穿着粗布短衫帮着搬运货物的，挎着竹篮叫卖海产的，蹲在栈桥边缘用尾巴尖轻轻点着水面、像是在等什么鱼自己上钩的……
content_en:
"I didn't expect that my talent for illusion can be used in sea fishing. There is really no end to my learning!"
Lilith was squatting on the side of the boat and throwing the string into the sea. At the same time, she used illusion magic to guide the nearby fish to bite the bait.
In this way, you can practice and entertain at the same time.
What a genius idea!
Just as he was thinking happily, he suddenly caught a glimpse of a gray-blue outline on the sea level from the corner of his eye.
"Is this... land? Master! There is land ahead!"
She threw away the rope, jumped up from the wooden box, and pointed at the faint outline of the land ahead.
Ji Tian was watching Elena and Ophelia playing chess at this time, and he had already noticed the island group.
The largest island in the center is the Lion's Tooth City as shown on the map. You can vaguely see the gray-white stone buildings extending from the coast to halfway up the mountain.
After traveling some distance further, the ship sailed towards the port of Lion Tooth City.
There are dozens of ships of various sizes moored in the port, including merchant ships, fishing boats, and several patrol ships flying church flags.
The most eye-catching thing is a stone lighthouse built at the entrance of the port. The tower is painted with red and white stripes, and the top is inlaid with a huge magic crystal.
The voice of Evelin, the captain of the Puffin, came from the steering wheel:
"We have arrived at Lion's Tooth City. It is the second largest free port in the Southern Islands and one of the few ports in this area with a Kingdom garrison. I docked the ship to the west pier, which is relatively close to the security station and the port management office."
The Puffin slowed down slowly, its sails were furled by the sailors one after another, and the hull slid into the harbor breakwater with the remaining momentum.
Evelin skillfully controlled the steering wheel, allowing the ship to smoothly approach the stone berth on the west pier.
A crowd of spectators quickly gathered on the pier.
The wood of the ship's hull lightly touched the stone pier, making a dull sound. The sailors threw out the cables and tied the ship neatly.
Evelin patted the dust on her hands and said, "We're here, you can do your business first, I'll guard the ship."
Ji Tian jumped off the boat and his boots landed on the stone slab of the dock, making a crisp sound. The dock workers and nearby port clerks looked over at him.
The silver-white brave light armor on his body shone coldly in the afternoon sun, and the holy sword hung on his waist, which was particularly conspicuous at the dock of the Free Port.
Several dock workers whispered to each other, and some of them had already recognized the brave emblem on his shoulder armor.
"Is that...a hero?"
"No way? Why did the brave man come to the southern sea? Shouldn't he be taking risks on the mainland?"
"Look at the sword on his waist, it's exactly the same as what the church advertises."
"But...didn't it mean that this generation of braves still has the Holy Mountain?"
"The island is the territory of the church. How could anyone dare to pretend to be a brave man? I guess only people with devout faith can see the Holy Mountain."
"I saw it, what a huge mountain!"
"Me...me too."
"..."
While the pedestrians were observing Ji Tian and others, Ji Tian and others were also observing the pedestrians.
The orcs on the dock caught Ji Tian's attention.
It is not uncommon to see cat-eared orcs with fluffy cat ears and a slender tail trailing behind them in the crowd:
There are people wearing coarse cloth shirts who help carry goods, and people carrying bamboo baskets selling seafood. They squat on the edge of the pier and tap the water surface with the tip of their tails, as if they are waiting for some fish to take the bait...
